messages:
Sam: FYI ChunkPay reported sustained p95 token latency and a few 5xxs during large batch ingest around 09:12 UTC, saying 'timeouts on 10% of requests'
Maria: linking the customer report and logs: https://redwood.internal/ops/links/CHUNK-4321 :eyes:
Sam: logs show retry storms and queue length on the text-gen pool increasing from 20 -> 240 in ~3m. snippet from router: 
```
WARN router: queue_size=243 route=gen-text pool=shared-small reason=backpressure
ERROR handler: request timeout after 12.0s id=req-0a12b
```
Jason: looks like the shared-small pool hit a concurrency cap after the new batching heuristic landed in last week's deploy (rev d8c7). Could be batching merging many small requests into large ones.
Hana: I just checked deploy bot — the batching change rolled at 03:28 UTC yesterday: `merge-batches-if-latency-ok` enabled for shared pools.
Luis: Customer's workload is mostly short prompts but high qps. If batches are large we push seq len up and cause kernel path to spike.
Sam: Can we reproduce? Maria, can you paste a minimal repro script that mimics their ingestion size?
Maria: putting a repro in #eng-runtime but quick example: 
```
for i in range(1200):
  POST /v1/generate {"prompt":"short","max_tokens":256}
  sleep(0.05)
```
Jason: I'll run that against staging with the new batching config toggled. If it reproduces, we can confirm regression from batching heuristic.
Kate (Product): tagging product — ChunkPay is an enterprise customer on Dedicated trial. They flagged potential SLA breach. We need triage outcome and recommended mitigation asap so CS can respond.
Sam: Triage checklist: 1) Confirm repro 2) Short-term mitigation (route ChunkPay -> dedicated pool or revert heuristic) 3) Patch/workplan for rollout
Hana: Short-term: I can add an override route to send traffic from ChunkPay org-id -> dedicated-pool-2, will take ~15m if infra approves.
Luis: Alternatively we can set max_batch_tokens=512 for shared-small to limit batch growth, that's a config flip and low-risk.
Maria: Customer wants low-latency option; they prefer dedicated pool if cost acceptable. We should offer temporary routing + schedule a fix.
Jason: Ran repro on staging with heuristic ON: p95 token latency ~420ms -> 1.6s under load, queue sizes match. With heuristic OFF, p95 ~360ms and queue stays <40. Not catastrophic but customer saw timeouts due to their client retry policy.
Sam: Good, that nails it to batching heuristic. Patch candidate: change merge threshold and introduce per-org batch cap. Jason can own the fix, Hana can own rollout gating.
Kate (Product): Prioritization ask: this is P1 for ChunkPay until we have mitigation in place. Put an entry in product backlog: "per-org batching caps + routing override UI". CS will offer dedicated pool + credit for disruption.
Jason: I'll open RFC/PR today: title 'per-org batch cap, config toggle, test harness' and include benchmark. ETA EOD for PR, EOW for rollout behind feature flag.
Hana: Doing the routing override now, infra-bot will post when route is active.
infra-bot: Route applied: org=chunkpay -> pool=dedicated-pool-2 (applied by Hana).
Maria: Customer updated: now ~10% errors dropped to 0 after routing. They confirm improvement. :tada:
Sam: Next steps: Jason PR, Hana keep route for 72h, Kate update CS message and backlog ticket, Luis follow-up on kernel-impact analysis for batching.
Kate (Product): I'll create the backlog ticket and attach customer notes. We should schedule a quick sync tomorrow 09:30 UTC to lock scope.
Luis: I'll instrument per-path token histograms to validate any future heuristic changes.
Sam: Thanks all. Closing thread for now but keep updates in this thread. If anything regresses reopen.
